correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the real unweighted relative l1 projection problem on Z=ker incidence for K_r join independent_s, r>=2,s>=1. Signed edge permutations make symmetry averaging norm-nonincreasing even for unrestricted projections; the cut/cycle real representation overlap is a single W_r, giving precisely one free equivariant correction parameter. The explicit pseudoinverse L^+ acts by 1/(r+s) on clique contrasts and 1/r on independent contrasts; its two absolute column-sum functions F_A and F_X are convex. The crossing on [-s/r,1] for s<=3 and the cross-column cusp at -s/r for s>=4 yield respectively 3-6/(r+s)+6s(r-4)(s-1)/[r(r+s)(6s+(r-1)(4-s))] and 3(r-1)/r. Independently built the oriented incidence matrices and grounded Laplacian inverses, then the full P_t in SymPy rationals; verified P_t^2=P_t and exact optimal column norm for r,s=(2,1),(2,4),(3,2),(4,3),(5,4),(6,5), covering small symmetric-group boundaries. Infinite-family minimality follows from the symmetry/representation and convexity proof, not this finite grid.
